sections.title: Dividend Policy
sections.excerpt:
DIVIDEND POLICY We have historically paid regular quarterly dividends on our common stock. However, the declaration of dividends is at the discretion
of our board of directors and any future payments of dividends, and the amount of any dividends we pay, will depend on, among other things, our financial condition, capital requirements and results of operations, as well as other factors that our
board of directors may consider relevant. In addition, so long as any share of our Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock remains outstanding, we may not declare or pay any dividend on our common stock unless all accumulated and unpaid dividends on
the Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock for all preceding dividend periods have been declared and paid, or a sufficient sum or number of shares of common stock has been set apart for their payment, subject to limited exceptions. See
